tests.reason: The CapabilityStatement advertises $questionnaire-package only. Mendari serves no $next-question, $log-questionnaire-errors or ValueSet/$expand, so it does not claim them (a declared partial DTR payer service; the owner decides whether to add them).

tests.title: Questionnaires include relevance logic
tests.reason: Each questionnaire asks only the documentation the decision table needs for the order's service and payer, chosen on the server. No question depends on another's answer, so none carries enableWhen or enableWhenExpression.

tests.title: Questionnaire flow and rendering expressions use CQL
tests.reason: The questionnaires hold no Expression elements: no flow or rendering logic.

tests.title: Questionnaire expressions include compiled JSON ELM
tests.reason: The questionnaires hold no CQL, so no ELM accompanies it.

tests.title: Questionnaires support EHR prepopulation
tests.reason: Mendari fills the QuestionnaireResponse on the server from the agent's decision (DTR allows that), and its questionnaires carry no CQL or initial expressions for the EHR to run. The agent's criteria come from its decision logic, which is not written as EHR-side CQL: a design gap, not a bug.

tests.title: All referenced CQL Libraries are included
tests.reason: The questionnaires need no CQL Library, so the packages hold none.

tests.title: Contained Binary resources are PDFs or safe XHTML
tests.reason: No QuestionnaireResponse contains a Binary.

tests.title: ValueSet expansions use the current date and active codes
tests.reason: No ValueSet comes back in a package, so Inferno makes no ValueSet/$expand request; Mendari serves no ValueSet/$expand (see 1.01).

tests.title: Questionnaire package response includes a warning for an unknown Questionnaire
Source data errors return a 4xx response with an OperationOutcome
Invalid QuestionnaireResponses return 400 with an OperationOutcome
tests.reason: Mendari serves no $next-question, so the invalid QuestionnaireResponse gets a 404, not a 400 with an OperationOutcome (see 1.01).

tests.title: Server provides Questionnaire Package Output Parameters must support elements
Server provides Questionnaire Package Bundle must support elements
tests.reason: The package Bundles hold the Questionnaire and its QuestionnaireResponse only: no ValueSet or Library entries, since the questionnaires need neither.

tests.title: Server provides common DTR Questionnaire must support elements and extensions
tests.reason: The questionnaires use few of the base profile's must-support elements: flat required choice questions, answered inline, with no effective period, prefixes, nested items, initial values, launch context, variables or CQL library.

tests.title: Server provides standard Questionnaire must support elements and extensions
tests.reason: No question carries enableWhen or enableWhenExpression (see 3.4.01).
